AppliedParameters.description:
Applied parameters used in sizing calculation.

This shows what default values were actually used, useful for:
- Debugging: verify which defaults took effect
- Transparency: user can see exact values used
- Reproducibility: re-run with explicit values

Note: Only includes parameters with defaults that affect results.

degradation_cost_pln_mwh.description: Degradation cost rate used [PLN/MWh]. Default: 50. Set to 0 to disable degradation cost.
degradation_cost_pln_mwh.title: Degradation Cost Pln Mwh

discount_rate.description: Discount rate used for NPV calculation
discount_rate.title: Discount Rate

opex_pct_per_year.description: OPEX as % of CAPEX per year
opex_pct_per_year.title: Opex Pct Per Year

AppliedParameters.title: AppliedParameters

BatteryTraceTimeseries.description:
Per-step battery trace timeseries (v2.2.0 SSoT).

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for battery state and power flows
at each timestep during dispatch simulation.

Returned only when include_battery_trace=true to avoid payload bloat.

Used for:
- Debugging: verify SOC evolution and charge/discharge decisions
- Transparency: user can see exact power flows at each timestep
- Validation: SOC bounds and power limits invariants
- Visualization: chart SOC and power over time

battery_energy_kwh.description: Battery energy capacity [kWh] for SOC bounds validation
battery_energy_kwh.title: Battery Energy Kwh

battery_power_kw.description: Battery power capacity [kW] for power limits validation
battery_power_kw.title: Battery Power Kw

charge_from_grid_kw.description: Charge from grid at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Only with allow_grid_charging. Length = steps.
charge_from_grid_kw.title: Charge From Grid Kw

charge_from_pv_kw.description: Charge from PV surplus at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Length = steps.
charge_from_pv_kw.title: Charge From Pv Kw

charge_kw.description: Battery charge power at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Length = steps.
charge_kw.title: Charge Kw

discharge_kw.description: Battery discharge power at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Length = steps.
discharge_kw.title: Discharge Kw

discharge_to_grid_kw.description: Discharge to grid (export) at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Length = steps.
discharge_to_grid_kw.title: Discharge To Grid Kw

discharge_to_load_kw.description: Discharge to load at each timestep [kW]. All values >= 0. Length = steps.
discharge_to_load_kw.title: Discharge To Load Kw

soc_kwh.description: Battery SOC at end of each timestep [kWh]. Length = steps.
soc_kwh.title: Soc Kwh

BatteryTraceTimeseries.title: BatteryTraceTimeseries

CacheInfo.description:
Cache metadata for a sizing result.

Enables deterministic result retrieval and debugging.

cache_status.description: Whether result was from cache (hit) or freshly computed (miss)

cached_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when result was cached. None for cache misses.
cached_at.title: Cached At

request_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical request JSON. Same inputs always produce same hash.
request_hash.title: Request Hash

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this computation run (UUID). Different for each new computation, same for cache hits.
run_id.title: Run Id

ttl_seconds.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds. None if caching disabled.
ttl_seconds.title: Ttl Seconds

CacheInfo.title: CacheInfo

CashflowYear.description:
Annual cashflow data for a single year.

Used for building cashflow tables and charts in UI.
Year 0 represents the initial investment (negative CAPEX).

cumulative_cashflow_pln.description: Cumulative undiscounted cashflow up to this year
cumulative_cashflow_pln.title: Cumulative Cashflow Pln

nominal_cashflow_pln.description: Undiscounted net cashflow = net_cashflow_pln (for IRR calculation convenience)
nominal_cashflow_pln.title: Nominal Cashflow Pln

CashflowYear.title: CashflowYear

ConstraintSummary.description:
Summary of grid constraint impacts (v0.7.0).

Tracks how often and how much constraints were hit during dispatch.

export_cap_curtailed_kwh.description: Total energy curtailed due to export cap [kWh]
export_cap_curtailed_kwh.title: Export Cap Curtailed Kwh

export_cap_hit_steps.description: Number of timesteps where export was capped by max_export_kw
export_cap_hit_steps.title: Export Cap Hit Steps

import_cap_hit_steps.description: Number of timesteps where import was capped by max_import_kw
import_cap_hit_steps.title: Import Cap Hit Steps

unserved_load_kwh.description: Total energy unserved due to import cap [kWh]
unserved_load_kwh.title: Unserved Load Kwh

ConstraintSummary.title: ConstraintSummary

ConstraintViolation.description:
Details of a single constraint violation (v0.8.0).

Used to explain why a variant is not feasible.

actual.description: The actual value that violated the constraint
actual.title: Actual

code.description: Constraint code: MAX_CAPEX, MAX_PAYBACK, MIN_NPV, MIN_NET_SAVINGS, NO_UNSERVED_LOAD, MAX_UNSERVED_LOAD
code.title: Code

ConstraintViolation.title: ConstraintViolation

ConstraintsReport.description:
Summary of constraint evaluation results (v0.8.0).

Provides overview of how many variants are feasible and which ones.

applied.description: True if constraints_config was provided in request
applied.title: Applied

none_feasible.description: True if no variants are feasible (recommended is fallback)
none_feasible.title: None Feasible

ConstraintsReport.title: ConstraintsReport

DebugEvents.description:
Debug events summary (v1.8.0).

Aggregates key debugging information from constraint_summary and energy_flows
into a single, easy-to-read block for debugging and repro analysis.

export_limited_steps.description: Steps where export was limited by max_export_kw
export_limited_steps.title: Export Limited Steps

import_limited_steps.description: Steps where import was limited by max_import_kw
import_limited_steps.title: Import Limited Steps

steps.description: Total number of timesteps in simulation
steps.title: Steps

DebugEvents.title: DebugEvents

arb_charge_from_grid_kwh.description: Energy charged from grid for arbitrage [kWh]
arb_charge_from_grid_kwh.title: Arb Charge From Grid Kwh

days_exceeding_cycle_limit.description: Days where daily cycle limit was exceeded
days_exceeding_cycle_limit.title: Days Exceeding Cycle Limit

days_exceeding_throughput_limit.description: Days where daily throughput limit was exceeded
days_exceeding_throughput_limit.title: Days Exceeding Throughput Limit

max_daily_efc.description: Max EFC in any single day
max_daily_efc.title: Max Daily Efc

max_daily_throughput_mwh.description: Max throughput in any single day [MWh]
max_daily_throughput_mwh.title: Max Daily Throughput Mwh

n_days.description: Number of days in analysis period
n_days.title: N Days

peak_events_count.description: Number of hours with peak shaving discharge
peak_events_count.title: Peak Events Count

peak_events_energy_kwh.description: Total energy discharged for peak shaving [kWh]
peak_events_energy_kwh.title: Peak Events Energy Kwh

peak_max_discharge_kw.description: Maximum discharge power for peak shaving [kW]
peak_max_discharge_kw.title: Peak Max Discharge Kw

DiscountRateSensitivityPoint.description:
NPV at a specific discount rate.

Used for discount rate sensitivity charts showing how NPV varies
with different discount rate assumptions.
DiscountRateSensitivityPoint.title: DiscountRateSensitivityPoint

battery_trace.description: Per-step battery trace if include_battery_trace=True. Shows soc_kwh, charge_kw, discharge_kw at each timestep for dispatch debugging.

constraint_summary.description: Summary of grid constraint impacts (export_cap_hit_steps, curtailed_kwh, etc.)

debug_events.description: Summary of debug events (caps/curtail/unserved) for debugging and repro analysis

economics_breakdown.description: Detailed economics breakdown. totals_pln always present, timeseries_pln only on request.

energy_flows.description: Detailed energy flows. totals_mwh always present, timeseries_kwh only on request.

prices_summary.description: Summary of prices used in simulation (or ToU cost breakdown)
prices_summary.title: Prices Summary

savings_breakdown.description: Detailed breakdown of savings by source (energy, arbitrage, capacity fee, etc.)

EconomicsBreakdown.description:
Complete economics breakdown structure (v1.5.0).

Contains:
- totals_pln: Always present (aggregate values matching savings_breakdown)
- timeseries_pln: Only when requested via include_economics_timeseries flag

Usage invariants:
- sum(timeseries_pln.energy_cost_baseline_pln) ≈ totals_pln.energy_cost_baseline_pln
- totals_pln.energy_savings_pln ≈ savings_breakdown.energy_savings_pln

timeseries_pln.description: Per-timestep values in PLN (only if include_economics_timeseries=True)

EconomicsBreakdown.title: EconomicsBreakdown

EconomicsTimeseriesPln.description:
Per-timestep economics in PLN.

Only included when include_economics_timeseries=True.
Useful for debugging and detailed economic analysis.

Invariants:
- sum(energy_cost_baseline_pln) = totals.energy_cost_baseline_pln
- sum(energy_cost_project_pln) = totals.energy_cost_project_pln
- sum(capacity_fee_pln) = totals.capacity_fee_project_pln (if applicable)
EconomicsTimeseriesPln.title: EconomicsTimeseriesPln

EconomicsTotalsPln.description:
Aggregate economics totals in PLN for the analysis period.

Always present in EconomicsBreakdown (small payload).
These are per-period totals that sum up to the same values as savings_breakdown.
EconomicsTotalsPln.title: EconomicsTotalsPln

EnergyFlows.description:
Complete energy flows structure.

Contains:
- totals_mwh: Always present (small, for UI and golden tests)
- timeseries_kwh: Only when requested via include_energy_flows_timeseries flag

Usage invariants:
- sum(timeseries_kwh) / 1000 ≈ totals_mwh (within floating point tolerance)
- Load balance: load_kwh[t] ≈ pv_to_load[t] + batt_to_load[t] + grid_import[t]

timeseries_kwh.description: Per-timestep values in kWh (only if include_energy_flows_timeseries=True)

EnergyFlows.title: EnergyFlows

EnergyFlowsTimeseriesKwh.description:
Per-timestep energy flows in kWh.

Only included in response when include_energy_flows_timeseries=True.
Useful for debugging and detailed analysis.

batt_charge_from_grid_kwh.description: Battery charge from grid per step [kWh]
batt_charge_from_grid_kwh.title: Batt Charge From Grid Kwh

EnergyFlowsTimeseriesKwh.title: EnergyFlowsTimeseriesKwh

EnergyFlowsTotalsMwh.description:
Total energy flows in MWh for the analysis period.

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for energy accounting.
All values are in MWh and represent totals over the period.

pv_to_load_mwh.description: PV energy directly consumed by load [MWh]
pv_to_load_mwh.title: Pv To Load Mwh

EnergyFlowsTotalsMwh.title: EnergyFlowsTotalsMwh

Feasibility.description:
Per-variant feasibility status (v0.8.0).

Indicates whether a variant satisfies all user-defined constraints.

is_feasible.description: True if variant satisfies all constraints
is_feasible.title: Is Feasible

violations.description: List of constraint violations (empty if feasible)
violations.title: Violations

Feasibility.title: Feasibility

FinanceAssumptions.description:
Echo of finance parameters applied in calculation.

Returned in response so user can verify what values were used,
especially when using defaults.

capex_override_pln.description: CAPEX override if provided, None if using calculated CAPEX
capex_override_pln.title: Capex Override Pln

replacement_capex_pln.description: Replacement cost used, None if no replacement
replacement_capex_pln.title: Replacement Capex Pln

replacement_year.description: Year for battery replacement, None if no replacement
replacement_year.title: Replacement Year

FinanceAssumptions.title: FinanceAssumptions

FinanceSummary.description:
Financial summary per variant.

Provides key financial metrics in one place for easy UI display.
NPV here is the same value used for scoring (when objective=npv)
and displayed in top_variants_details.

capex_sensitivity.description: NPV at different CAPEX multipliers. Only present when capex_multiplier_sweep provided.
capex_sensitivity.title: Capex Sensitivity

cashflow_timeseries.description: Year-by-year cashflow breakdown. Only present when include_cashflow_timeseries=True.
cashflow_timeseries.title: Cashflow Timeseries

discount_rate_sensitivity.description: NPV at different discount rates. Only present when discount_rate_sweep provided.
discount_rate_sensitivity.title: Discount Rate Sensitivity

energy_price_sensitivity.description: NPV at different energy price multipliers. Only present when energy_price_multiplier_sweep provided.
energy_price_sensitivity.title: Energy Price Sensitivity

irr_pct.description: Internal Rate of Return [%]. Null if IRR not calculated.
irr_pct.title: Irr Pct

FinanceSummary.title: FinanceSummary

GridConstraintsApplied.description:
Echo of grid constraints applied in calculation (v0.7.0).

Returned in response so user can verify what constraints were used,
including computed effective values (e.g., max_export_kw=0 when allow_export=False).
GridConstraintsApplied.title: GridConstraintsApplied

LedgerTimeseriesPlnPerStep.description:
Per-step cost timeseries in PLN for each timestep (v2.0.0 SSoT).

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-step economics.
All values are arrays of length 'steps' (matching period_info.steps).

Used for:
- Debugging: see cost contributions at each timestep
- Transparency: user can trace costs back to energy flows
- Validation: sum of arrays should match MoneyLedger totals (invariant)
- Visualization: chart stacked costs over time

export_revenue_pln.description: Export revenue at each timestep [PLN]. Positive = revenue. Length = steps.
export_revenue_pln.title: Export Revenue Pln

import_cost_pln.description: Grid import cost at each timestep [PLN]. Length = steps.
import_cost_pln.title: Import Cost Pln

net_cost_pln.description: Net cost at each timestep [PLN] = import + fees + penalty - export. Length = steps.
net_cost_pln.title: Net Cost Pln

other_fees_pln.description: Other fees at each timestep [PLN]. Length = steps.
other_fees_pln.title: Other Fees Pln

sum_export_revenue_pln.description: Sum of export_revenue_pln array [PLN]. Should match MoneyLedger.
sum_export_revenue_pln.title: Sum Export Revenue Pln

sum_import_cost_pln.description: Sum of import_cost_pln array [PLN]. Should match MoneyLedger.
sum_import_cost_pln.title: Sum Import Cost Pln

sum_net_cost_pln.description: Sum of net_cost_pln array [PLN]. Should match MoneyLedger.total_cost_pln.
sum_net_cost_pln.title: Sum Net Cost Pln

sum_other_fees_pln.description: Sum of other_fees_pln array [PLN]. Should match MoneyLedger.
sum_other_fees_pln.title: Sum Other Fees Pln

sum_unserved_penalty_pln.description: Sum of unserved_penalty_pln array [PLN]. Should match MoneyLedger.
sum_unserved_penalty_pln.title: Sum Unserved Penalty Pln

unserved_penalty_pln.description: Unserved load penalty at each timestep [PLN]. Length = steps.
unserved_penalty_pln.title: Unserved Penalty Pln

LedgerTimeseriesPlnPerStep.title: LedgerTimeseriesPlnPerStep

MoneyLedger.description:
Complete money ledger comparing baseline vs project costs (v1.9.0 SSoT).

Provides full cost breakdown for:
- baseline_period: Costs for the analysis period WITHOUT battery
- project_period: Costs for the analysis period WITH battery
- delta_period_pln: Difference (baseline - project) for period
- baseline_annual: Annualized costs WITHOUT battery
- project_annual: Annualized costs WITH battery
- delta_annual_pln: Annualized difference (baseline - project)

The delta values represent SAVINGS (positive = money saved).
delta.total_cost_pln should match net_savings_pln (SSoT reconciliation).

baseline_period.description: Baseline costs for the analysis period (no battery)

delta_annual_pln.description: Delta (baseline - project) annualized = annual savings per category

delta_period_pln.description: Delta (baseline - project) for period = savings per category

is_full_year.description: True if analysis period is exactly 8760 hours (1 year)
is_full_year.title: Is Full Year

period_hours.description: Number of hours in analysis period
period_hours.title: Period Hours

project_period.description: Project costs for the analysis period (with battery)

MoneyLedger.title: MoneyLedger

MoneyLedgerTotalsPln.description:
Cost breakdown totals for a scenario (baseline or project).

All values in PLN. Costs are positive, revenue is positive but subtracted
from total_cost (so higher revenue = lower total_cost).

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for cost accounting.

demand_charge_pln.description: Demand charge / peak shaving fee (opłata za moc umowną) [PLN]
demand_charge_pln.title: Demand Charge Pln

export_revenue_pln.description: Revenue from exporting energy to grid [PLN] - positive value
export_revenue_pln.title: Export Revenue Pln

import_energy_cost_pln.description: Cost of importing energy from grid [PLN] - includes ToU rate
import_energy_cost_pln.title: Import Energy Cost Pln

other_fees_pln.description: Other fees [PLN]: OZE, kogeneracja, jakość, akcyza
other_fees_pln.title: Other Fees Pln

total_cost_pln.description: Total net cost [PLN] = import + fees + penalties - export_revenue
total_cost_pln.title: Total Cost Pln

unserved_penalty_pln.description: Penalty for unserved load due to import constraints [PLN]
unserved_penalty_pln.title: Unserved Penalty Pln

MoneyLedgerTotalsPln.title: MoneyLedgerTotalsPln

MultiplierSensitivityPoint.description:
NPV at a specific multiplier value (v0.6.0 PR4).

Used for energy price and CAPEX sensitivity charts showing how NPV varies
with different price/cost assumptions.
MultiplierSensitivityPoint.title: MultiplierSensitivityPoint

ParetoPoint.description:
A point on the Pareto frontier for NPV vs Payback trade-off (v0.8.0).

A variant is Pareto-optimal (non-dominated) if no other variant has:
- Higher NPV AND lower payback simultaneously

Variants on the frontier represent optimal trade-offs.

is_dominated.description: True if this variant is dominated by another (not on Pareto frontier)
is_dominated.title: Is Dominated

ParetoPoint.title: ParetoPoint

PeriodInfo.description:
Period information included in responses.

Helps UI understand whether results are for a full year or partial period,
and whether annualization was applied.

New fields (v0.3.3):
- steps: number of time steps in analysis
- step_minutes: time resolution (15 or 60)
- timezone: timezone string (e.g., "Europe/Warsaw")

annualization_factor.description: 8760 / period_hours. Use to scale to annual if needed.
annualization_factor.title: Annualization Factor

PeriodInfo.title: PeriodInfo

PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh.description:
Per-step price timeseries in PLN/MWh (v2.0.0 SSoT).

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what prices were used in calculations.
All values are arrays of length 'steps' (matching period_info.steps).

Used for:
- Debugging: verify which prices were applied at each timestep
- Transparency: user can see exact ToU zone mapping
- Reproducibility: export prices + use as override for deterministic replay
- Validation: sum(price * energy) should match MoneyLedger totals

export_price_pln_per_mwh.description: Grid export price at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
export_price_pln_per_mwh.title: Export Price Pln Per Mwh

import_price_pln_per_mwh.description: Grid import price at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
import_price_pln_per_mwh.title: Import Price Pln Per Mwh

other_fees_pln_per_mwh.description: Other fees (OZE, kogeneracja, etc.) at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
other_fees_pln_per_mwh.title: Other Fees Pln Per Mwh

timezone.description: Timezone used for ToU zone mapping
timezone.title: Timezone

unserved_penalty_pln_per_kwh.description: Unserved load penalty at each timestep [PLN/kWh]. Length = steps.
unserved_penalty_pln_per_kwh.title: Unserved Penalty Pln Per Kwh

PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh.title: PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh

PricesSummary.description:
Summary of prices used in simulation.

For transparency - user can verify what assumptions were used.

tariff_id.description: OSD tariff preset ID if used
tariff_id.title: Tariff Id

zone_rates.description: Zone rates if ToU tariff [PLN/MWh], e.g. {'peak': 950, 'partial': 700, 'off_peak': 450}
zone_rates.title: Zone Rates

PricesSummary.title: PricesSummary

SavingsBreakdown.description:
Detailed breakdown of annual savings by source.

Used for transparent NPV calculation and frontend display.
Sum of all components equals net_savings_pln.

NOTE on terminology:
- demand_charge_savings_pln = peak shaving (opłata za moc umowną / demand charge)
- capacity_fee_savings_pln = opłata mocowa PL (rynek mocy) - osobny moduł
- export_revenue_pln = revenue from grid export (sprzedaż nadwyżek do sieci)

arbitrage_savings_pln.description: ADDITIONAL savings from ToU price spread (tou_total - flat_savings)
arbitrage_savings_pln.title: Arbitrage Savings Pln

baseline_export_revenue_pln.description: Export revenue WITHOUT battery (PV surplus only)
baseline_export_revenue_pln.title: Baseline Export Revenue Pln

capacity_fee_savings_pln.description: Savings from reduced capacity fee (opłata mocowa PL)
capacity_fee_savings_pln.title: Capacity Fee Savings Pln

demand_charge_savings_pln.description: Savings from peak shaving (opłata za moc / demand charge)
demand_charge_savings_pln.title: Demand Charge Savings Pln

energy_savings_pln.description: Savings from reduced grid import at flat price (volume × flat_rate)
energy_savings_pln.title: Energy Savings Pln

export_revenue_pln.description: [DEPRECATED] Use project_export_revenue_pln instead. This field equals project_export_revenue_pln for backward compatibility.
export_revenue_pln.title: Export Revenue Pln

export_revenue_savings_pln.description: Change in export revenue = project - baseline (typically negative)
export_revenue_savings_pln.title: Export Revenue Savings Pln

net_savings_pln.description: Net annual savings = energy + demand + arbitrage + capacity_fee + export_delta - degradation - unserved_penalty
net_savings_pln.title: Net Savings Pln

project_export_revenue_pln.description: Export revenue WITH battery (reduced due to self-consumption)
project_export_revenue_pln.title: Project Export Revenue Pln

unserved_load_penalty_pln.description: Penalty for unserved load due to import cap [PLN]
unserved_load_penalty_pln.title: Unserved Load Penalty Pln

SavingsBreakdown.title: SavingsBreakdown

SizingVariantResult.description: Result for a single sizing variant

battery_trace.description: Per-step battery trace if include_battery_trace=True. Shows soc_kwh, charge_kw, discharge_kw at each timestep for dispatch debugging.

feasibility.description: Feasibility status based on constraints_config. is_feasible=True if variant satisfies all constraints, with violations list.

finance_summary.description: Financial summary with CAPEX, OPEX, NPV, payback. NPV here matches npv_pln used for scoring and top_variants_details.

invariants.description: Invariant check results if include_invariants=True. Contains energy_balance_ok, non_negative_ok, cost_sums_ok, annualization_ok.
invariants.title: Invariants

ledger_timeseries.description: Per-step cost timeseries if include_ledger_timeseries=True. Shows import_cost/export_revenue/fees/penalty at each timestep for charts.

money_ledger.description: Money ledger with baseline/project cost breakdown if include_money_ledger=True. Provides full transparency into cost categories and reconciliation.

price_hash.description: SHA256 hash of canonical price_timeseries JSON. Stable identifier for price set - same prices = same hash.
price_hash.title: Price Hash

price_timeseries.description: Per-step price timeseries if include_price_timeseries=True. Shows import/export/fees prices at each timestep for debugging and replay.

pricing_mode.description: Source of prices: 'generated' (from ToU/PriceConfig) or 'override' (from price_timeseries_override). Set when include_price_timeseries=True.
pricing_mode.title: Pricing Mode

SizingVariantResult.title: SizingVariantResult

TopVariantDetail.description:
Detailed information about a top variant for UI display.

Contains key metrics for easy comparison in a table/list view.
TopVariantDetail.title: TopVariantDetail

description: Complete sizing result with all variants

applied_parameters.description: Parameters actually used in calculation. Shows effective defaults and sources for transparency.

cache_info.description: Cache metadata including request_hash, run_id, and cache_status. Enables deterministic result retrieval and debugging.

constraints_report.description: Summary of constraint evaluation: how many variants are feasible, which ones, and whether recommended is fallback due to none_feasible.

finance_assumptions.description: Echo of finance parameters applied in calculation. Shows what values were used (explicit or defaults).

grid_constraints_applied.description: Echo of grid constraints applied in calculation. Shows effective values (e.g., max_export_kw=0 when allow_export=False).

objective_used.description: Optimization objective that was used. Default is 'npv'. Values: npv, payback, self_consumption, peak_reduction, efc_utilization
objective_used.title: Objective Used

pareto_frontier.description: Pareto frontier for NPV vs Payback trade-off. Variants with is_dominated=False are on the frontier.
pareto_frontier.title: Pareto Frontier

period_info.description: Time axis metadata. period_hours replaces hardcoded 8760.

recommended_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this variant was recommended. Example: 'Highest NPV (45,230 PLN) among variants with payback < 8 years'
recommended_reason.title: Recommended Reason

recommended_reason_code.description: Machine-readable code for recommendation reason. Values: npv_max, payback_min, self_consumption_max, peak_reduction_max, efc_utilization_max, constrained_fallback
recommended_reason_code.title: Recommended Reason Code

recommended_reason_metric.description: Metric name used for recommendation. Values: npv_pln, payback_years, self_consumption_pct, peak_reduction_pct, efc_total
recommended_reason_metric.title: Recommended Reason Metric

recommended_reason_unit.description: Unit for the recommendation metric value. Values: PLN, years, %, cycles
recommended_reason_unit.title: Recommended Reason Unit

recommended_reason_value.description: Numeric value of the recommendation metric. Example: 45230.0 for NPV
recommended_reason_value.title: Recommended Reason Value

schema_version.description: API schema version. Bump when response structure changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

timeseries_info.description: Timeseries throttling metadata. Shows mode, included_steps, total_steps, and truncated flag for each timeseries type (battery_trace, ledger, price).
timeseries_info.title: Timeseries Info

top_variants.description: Top 3 variants ranked by score (highest first). Useful for UI to show alternatives. Example: ['medium', 'large', 'small']
top_variants.title: Top Variants

top_variants_details.description: Top 3 variants with key metrics for easy comparison. First element is always the recommended variant.
top_variants_details.title: Top Variants Details

title: SizingResult
